videos.headline: Dejuan Lane comes up with an interception
Picked! Jeremiah Telander hauls in the interception

End Zone! Daune Morris scores 47-yard rushing TD
Highlight: No. 18 Tennessee dominates Georgia Tech with 299 rushing yards
